description: Implement a real 3-state (closed/open/half-open) circuit breaker in place of a stub that always calls through
prompts: CircuitBreaker.cs's Call always just calls fn(). Implement the real 3-state machine: the constructor takes (int failureThreshold, long resetTimeout). Starts Closed. In Closed, Call(fn, now) invokes fn(); if it throws, count consecutive failures, and once `failureThreshold` CONSECUTIVE failures have happened, trip to Open (recording when it opened) and re-throw. While Open, Call must NOT invoke fn() at all and must instead throw CircuitOpenException - UNLESS at least `resetTimeout` seconds have passed since it opened, in which case it moves to HalfOpen and allows exactly ONE trial call: if that call succeeds, go back to Closed (reset the failure count); if it throws, go back to Open and RESET the open-time to `now` (so the next trial is only allowed after another full resetTimeout, not immediately). Add a CircuitOpenException class in the same file.
name: add_csharp_circuit_breaker_state_machine
